decisions.reason: Only the image block at the top changed: the blue-gradient banner is replaced by the Airframe banner that Sean-Koval/agent-factory generates for every product (scripts/banners.py), as a <picture> with Night and Day SVGs. Headings, text and commands are unchanged (asset-only change approved despite ADR 0001; it adds no feature).
Removed: the old hand-drawn blue-gradient README banner. Nothing referenced it except README.md line 1, which now uses docs/assets/brand/.

Newly vendored, unmodified: the README banner for Night, generated by agent-factory scripts/banners.py from Airframe tokens, marks and fonts (text outlined); fetched with scripts/sync-brand.sh theme-v6.
Newly vendored, unmodified: the README banner for Day, generated by agent-factory scripts/banners.py; fetched with scripts/sync-brand.sh theme-v6.
Newly vendored, unmodified: the ai-dlc favicon generated by agent-factory scripts/banners.py; mkdocs.yml theme.favicon points at it (the site had none).
Newly vendored, unmodified: the ai-dlc header mark generated by agent-factory scripts/banners.py; mkdocs.yml theme.logo points at it (the site showed Material's default book icon).
Newly vendored, unmodified: the 1280x640 GitHub social preview generated by agent-factory scripts/banners.py, kept here for the owner to upload in the repository settings (no API for that).
mkdocs.yml only gained theme.logo and theme.favicon (the vendored Airframe mark and favicon); the site's navigation, pages and the get-started procedure and its commands are unchanged.

New: agent-factory's brand/sync-brand.sh template with PRODUCT=ai-dlc; refreshes docs/assets/brand/ from a published ref (sh scripts/sync-brand.sh theme-vN), the way scripts/sync-airframe.sh refreshes the theme.
